Inline enum values:

### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 0x02 | `i2c_3p4mhz` | Module supports up to 3.4 MHz |
| 0x3..0xf | `reserved_3_f` | Reserved |

### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

These are IR projections, not independent verification against each historical specification. Unannotated fields default to all known family revisions in the resolver; missing historical semantics remain unsupported. Citations are preserved as recorded and may name a later revision. Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 2..3 | `reserved_2_3` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `twi_max_speed_cmis4`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 2..3 | `reserved_2_3` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 2..3 | `reserved_2_3` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 2..3 | `reserved_2_3` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 2..3 | `reserved_2_3` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 0x02 | `i2c_3p4mhz` | Module supports up to 3.4 MHz |
| 0x3..0xf | `reserved_3_f` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |

Inline enum values:

#### `memory_model`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `paged` | Paged memory (Pages 00h-02h, 10h-11h supported) |
| 0x01 | `flat` | Flat memory (Page 00h supported only) |

#### `mci_max_speed`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `i2c_400khz` | Module supports up to 400 kHz |
| 0x01 | `i2c_1mhz` | Module supports up to 1 MHz |
| 0x02 | `i2c_3p4mhz` | Module supports up to 3.4 MHz |
| 0x3..0xf | `reserved_3_f` | Reserved |

#### `interrupt_deasserted`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `asserted` | Interrupt asserted |
| 0x01 | `not_asserted` | Interrupt not asserted (default) |

#### `squelch_method_select`

| Value | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| 0x00 | `reduce_oma` | Squelching of Tx output reduces OMA |
| 0x01 | `reduce_pav` | Squelching of Tx output reduces Pav |
